senses.gloss: गेष r. 1st cl. (ऋ)गेषृ(गेषते) To seek, to search, to investigate.

गेष्ण m. (-ष्णः)
 1. A professional singer, an actor, a mime, &c.
 2. A chanter
of the Sama Veda.
 E. गै to sing, and इष्णच् Uṇādi aff.

गेष्णु m. (-ष्णुः)
 1. A singer.
 2. An actor.
 3. A chanter of the Sama
Veda: see गेष्ण
 E. गै to sing, and इष्णुच् Uṇādi aff.
